major_events: In [第1章 天黑别出门], the disabled elders of Border Village rescue baby Qin Mu from a floating basket in the river during the dangerous night, noting the glowing jade pendant that kept him safe from the dark creatures.

In [第1章 天黑别出门], Qin Mu witnesses Cripple slay the transformed wife of the Xianglong City Lord who was disguised as a dairy cow, giving him his first shocking glimpse of the violent reality of the Great Ruins.

In [第2章 四灵血], the village elders test Qin Mu's potential by having him consume blood derived from four spiritual beasts to check for a spirit body. Finding him a normal human, Chief invents the 'Overlord Body' (霸体) myth to keep him motivated.
In [第11章 破壁], Qin Mu uses the demonic chant learned in the temple to suppress the divine sounds in his mind, successfully cracking his Spiritual Embryo Wall (灵胎壁) and initiating his cultivation.

In [第22章 石像的秘密], Qin Mu battles the giant ape in the valley, developing his Thunder Voice Eight Methods (雷音八式) and discovering that the village's four stone statues possess a mysterious protective power against the dark creatures.
In [第32章 得见神枪], Qin Mu uses the 'Thousand-Hand Buddha' technique and the Heavenly Devil Free Will Seal to defeat the sword disciple Qian Qiu in Border Village, protecting the village from invaders.

In [第53章 示威], Ma Ye demonstrates the true power of the 'Nine Dragons Driving Wind and Thunder' punch, shattering a cloud where a spy monk is hiding, revealing the ongoing tension with the Great Thunderclap Temple.

In [第63章 十，太，圭], Qin Mu works with the skeletal centipede demoness Wu Nv, using his Young Protector Sword (少保剑) with her demonic energy to slash through the giant ice dam on the river, preventing a devastating flood.

In [第73章 花街刺杀], while in Xianglong City, Qin Mu is tracked by the City Lord's forces after killing the City Lord's son. He witnesses local hidden entities assassinating his pursuers and escapes using his martial arts.

In [第83章 终极武装], Qin Mu receives a message from the Heavenly Devil Cult's patriarch (祖师) inviting him to become the next Young Cult Master (少教主), prompting him to plan his journey out of the Great Ruins.

In [第94章 画龙点睛], Qin Mu passes Deaf's test by using his artistic comprehension and martial intents to 'dot the eyes' of a painted dragon, bringing it to life, showing his mastery over artistic conceptualization.

In [第104章 坏蛋出村], Granny Si decides to leave Border Village to find and protect Qin Mu in the outside world, followed secretly by Blind, Cripple, and Ma Ye, as they try to deal with their own pasts and enemies.

In [第114章 立时就死], Qin Mu diagnoses Imperial Physician Xiao in the capital's pleasure quarter, warning him that his internal toxins will kill him instantly if he gets angry, which happens shortly after when Xiao flies into a rage.

In [第135章 绕剑式], Imperial Preceptor (延康国师) delivers a lecture on the 'Winding Sword Form' (绕剑式) at the Imperial College, redefining basic sword techniques and opening Qin Mu's understanding of modern Taoist concepts.

In [第145章 翻修士子居], Qin Mu faces a collective challenge from the aristocratic scholars at the Imperial College and defeats them one by one, asserting the strength of the 'abandoned people' of the Great Ruins.
In [第156章 危险的想法], Qin Mu uses the skin-shedding technique of the Heavenly Devil Cult to disguise himself as a barbarian warrior, successfully infiltrating the core vault of the Loulan Golden Palace.
In [第186章 秦牧唤魔], during the military campaign, Qin Mu employs the forbidden 'Ghost Calling and God Dispatching' seal to summon the avatar of the Doutian Devil King (都天魔王) to aid in battle.
In [第236章 无忧乡], Qin Mu inherits the legacy of the Moon Guardian, merging with the Moon Boat to navigate the dark space of the dead, seeking the Carefree Village (无忧乡) where his family originates.
character_state_transitions: Qin Mu: An ordinary non-cultivating orphan child in [第1章 天黑别出门] -> A self-broken cultivator who shattered his own Spiritual Embryo Wall in [第11章 破壁].
Qin Mu: A normal human doubting his own potential in [第2章 四灵血] -> An extremely confident fighter believing himself to be the legendary 'Overlord Body' (霸体) in [第3章 神通].
Qin Mu: An isolated village boy in Border Village in [第1章 天黑别出门] -> The officially recognized Young Cult Master (少教主) of the Heavenly Devil Cult in [第83章 终极武装].
Granny Si: A stationary guardian of Qin Mu in Border Village in [第2章 四灵血] -> A wandering traveler pursuing her adopted son to the capital to protect him in [第104章 坏蛋出村].

Imperial Physician Xiao: A proud, arrogant Imperial Physician boasting of his invincibility in [第114章 立时就死] -> A dead corpse killed by his own mixed toxic reactions after flying into a rage as predicted by Qin Mu in [第114章 立时就死].
Wu Nv: A trapped, hostile skeletal centipede demon in [第63章 十，太，圭] -> An active contributor who helps Qin Mu slice through the ice dam to save the downstream population in [第63章 十，太，圭].
Qian Qiu: A confident sword disciple attacking Border Village in [第32章 得见神枪] -> A deceased body hung on a pillar with his soul shattered by Qin Mu in [第32章 得见神枪].
Qin Mu: A newly admitted student at the Imperial College in [第125章 师兄小毒王] -> The dominant fighter who single-handedly beats down the challenging scholars in [第145章 翻修士子居].
Doutian Devil King: A mighty extra-dimensional devil ruler in his own realm in [第186章 秦牧唤魔] -> A cautious consciousness trapped in Qin Mu's body, forced to trade information in [第207章 奸似鬼].

Qin Mu: A flesh-and-blood human reduced to a skeleton in the Netherworld in [第236章 无忧乡] -> A giant celestial-like entity merged with the Moon Boat to resist the rules of the Dead Realm in [第236章 无忧乡].

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Overlord Body Placebo (霸体臆造)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A psychological belief system created by Chief where Qin Mu is told he possesses the rare 'Overlord Body'. This absolute self-confidence allows him to cultivate with no psychological boundaries, achieving breakthroughs that normal humans cannot. [第3章 神通]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Seven Divine Treasures and Wall Barriers (七大境界与破壁)
long_form_mechanisms.description: The cultivation progression system where practitioners must break through the physical and spiritual barriers of the seven treasures (Spiritual Embryo, Five Elements, Six Unions, Seven Stars, Celestial Being, Life and Death, Divine Bridge) to advance. [第2章 四灵血]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Four Spirit Blood Refining (四灵血炼制)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A testing and enhancement process where blood from four spiritual-beast descendants is refined using specific insect eggs and white crystals to test if a person has a corresponding Spirit Body. [第2章 四灵血]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Thunder Voice Eight Methods (雷音八式)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A martial technique of the Great Thunderclap Temple that utilizes deep breathing, muscular vibrations, and vocal resonance (like the '千手佛陀' or '九龙驭风雷') to execute waves of kinetic and acoustic force. [第3章 神通]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Skin-Shedding and Disguise (天魔造化功)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A high-level technique from the Great Educational Heavenly Devil Scriptures (大育天魔经) that allows a practitioner to peel off the skin of another entity and wear it as a perfect physical disguise, adopting their face, voice, and aura. [第1章 天黑别出门]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Winding Sword Form (绕剑式)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A modern refinement of basic sword arts developed by the Imperial Preceptor, which adds new structural dynamics (like '绕') to the traditional fourteen styles of stabbing, slicing, and blocking, enabling a sword stream to bypass defenses dynamically. [第135章 绕剑式]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Ghost Calling and God Dispatching (调鬼遣神符字令)
long_form_mechanisms.description: An ancient summoner ritual from the Doutian Realm that uses specific runic formations to call forth extra-dimensional devil gods or their avatars into the mortal plane, requiring a host anchor. [第186章 秦牧唤魔]

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Moon Boat and Moon Guardian Legacy (月亮船与月亮守)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A titanic mountain-sized vessel shaped like a three-legged toad that draws upon the residual power of a dead moon. Controlling it grants the 'Moon Guardian' divine power but drains their life force by slowly fusing their physical body with the ship. [第236章 无忧乡]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Stone Statue Protective Arrays (石像辟邪阵法)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A passive defense system in the Great Ruins where ancient stone statues scattered throughout the land emit protective light fields at night, creating a sanctuary that keeps the malevolent dark creatures at bay. [第1章 天黑别出门]

continuity_observations: The mystery of Qin Mu's origins and his glowing jade pendant with the character '秦' is introduced in [第1章 天黑别出门] and directly leads to his search for the Carefree Village in [第236章 无忧乡].

Granny Si's secret affiliation with the Heavenly Devil Scriptures is hinted at in [第1章 天黑别出门] and later formalized when she transmits the teachings to Qin Mu, leading to his role as the Young Cult Master in [第83章 终极武装].

The 'Overlord Body' placebo created in [第2章 四灵血] by Chief and Apothecary remains a persistent driver for Qin Mu's entire growth arc, showing how psychological programming affects physical energy output.

Ma Ye's background as a former monk of the Great Thunderclap Temple is introduced through his Thunder Voice techniques in [第3章 神通] and culminates in the political conflict with his former sect in [第53章 示威].

The absolute rule '天黑别出门' (Don't go out in the dark) introduced in [第1章 天黑别出门] remains a foundational law of the Great Ruins, which Qin Mu eventually overcomes by borrowing the Moon Boat's divine light in [第236章 无忧乡].

The Doutian Devil King, summoned as a temporary combat tool in [第186章 秦牧唤魔], becomes a permanent passenger in Qin Mu's consciousness, acting as a reluctant advisor and translator in [第207章 奸似鬼] and [第227章 枯寂岭根妖].
Wu Nv's debt of gratitude to Qin Mu for cutting her chains is established in [第63章 十，太，圭] and remains a key link for her cooperation in resolving the river's ice dam crisis.

The Imperial Preceptor's vision of reforming martial arts and breaking sect monopolies, introduced in his lecture in [第135章 绕剑式], sets the political backdrop for Qin Mu's activities in the Imperial College.

Princess Ling Yuxiu's relationship with Qin Mu starts as a childhood encounter in the Great Ruins and continues at the Imperial College, where Qin Mu notes her growth and physical changes in [第125章 师兄小毒王].
style_observations: Humorous Dialectical Contrast: The author contrasts Qin Mu's blunt rural values (e.g. evaluating women based on their strength and reproductive capability) with the refined, polite sensibilities of the imperial city dwellers, creating a lighthearted tone. [第125章 师兄小毒王]

Processional Explanations: Combat and medical techniques are described with step-by-step pseudo-scientific logic (e.g. the precise chemical process of extracting beast blood using worms and white crystals), making the fantastic elements feel grounded. [第2章 四灵血]

Escalation of Spatial Scale: Fights transition from tight, close-quarters village brawls in Border Village to mountain-level disasters (clearing ice dams, summoning extra-dimensional gods, and steering mountain-sized toad ships), expanding the scope of the world. [第63章 十，太，圭], [第236章 无忧乡]

Calm Protagonist vs. Shocked Onlookers: A signature narrative pattern where Qin Mu performs highly dangerous or taboo actions (like using forbidden demonic arts or diagnosing a fatal illness) with absolute calm while seasoned experts look on in horror. [第114章 立时就死], [第145章 翻修士子居]

Integration of Folk Customs: The prose weaves traditional Chinese folk elements (such as stilt-walking, fire-breathing, pleasure quarter lanterns, and paper lanterns) into high-fantasy combat, enhancing the cultural texture of the setting. [第73章 花街刺杀]

Undercurrent of Tragic Past: Despite their comical and disabled appearances, the elders of Border Village are described with a melancholic weight, hinting at catastrophic pasts, betrayals, and political exile, which adds narrative depth. [第104章 坏蛋出村]
Rhythmic Onomatopoeia in Combat: Heavy use of sound descriptors (e.g., '轰隆', '咔嚓', '当啷', '嗤嗤嗤') that pace the action and give fights a heavy, physical rhythm. [第11章 破壁], [第32章 得见神枪]

creation_family_evidence.author: 宅猪 (Zhai Zhu)
key_concepts: 大育天魔经 (Great Educational Heavenly Devil Scriptures)
creation_family_evidence.stylistic_signature: Features a unique blend of dark fantasy (the Great Ruins night, skin-wearing devils, centipede demons) and lighthearted humor, driven by a protagonist who combines supreme self-confidence with pragmatic, rural survival instincts. The disabled mentors who are secret peerless masters is a hallmark trope of Zhai Zhu's early chapters.
creation_family_evidence.compilation_indicators: The chapter headings utilize uniform Chinese numbers followed by a space and the title (e.g., '第1章 天黑别出门', '第236章 无忧乡') and double-byte spacing at paragraph starts, indicating standard Zhi Xuan Cang Shu (知轩藏书) web serialization compilation formatting.

originality_risks: The 'Secret Master Village' Trope: Having a young protagonist raised by a group of disabled, retired, but secretly peerless masters in an isolated village is a highly common trope in Chinese wuxia/xianxia novels, similar to settings in novels like Kung Fu Hustle or The Legend of Condor Heroes. [第1章 天黑别出门]

Placebo Power Boost: Qin Mu's 'Overlord Body' being a complete lie that somehow unlocks real, ultimate potential is a comedic but mechanically thin device that relies heavily on 'mind over matter' tropes to bypass standard cultivation rules. [第3章 神通]

The Skin-Disguise Shortcut: The ability of characters to wear the skins of others (天魔造化功) to perfectly infiltrate secure locations without detection is a common Xianxia shorthand that can bypass complex security systems too easily, lowering stakes. [第156章 危险的想法]

Academy Face-Slapping Formula: The sequence of the protagonist arriving at a prestigious imperial academy, being mocked as a 'rural drop-out/弃民', and then beating up all the arrogant upper-class students one by one follows a standard web novel structure designed for immediate reader gratification. [第145章 翻修士子居]

The Extradimensional Demon as a Hostage/Host: Summoning a supreme lord of another dimension (都天魔王) only for him to be reduced to a locked-in companion who complains and trades tips is a common trope to give the protagonist a safe guide to ancient mysteries. [第207章 奸似鬼]
